name: Dumbbell Alternating Triceps Kickback
steps: Stand with feet hip-width apart holding dumbbells, knees soft, and hinge forward with a flat back.
Draw both bent elbows up beside your ribs so your upper arms align with your torso.
Straighten one elbow behind you until that arm extends fully past your hip.
Lower the forearm slowly back beneath your elbow and alternate arms.
tips: Keep both upper arms steady and parallel to your torso throughout.
Avoid swinging the dumbbells with momentum or rounding your lower back.
